statement: Pinned Linux and SDL consumers emit haptic output 0x80/0x81 and declare 0x82-0x85, but these files do not specify a device reply/ACK report for those wired writes; a 0x44 reply is a separate unconfirmed earlier research hypothesis and is not included in synthetic host output fixtures. No evidence for physical ACK timing or bytes. Kernel:328-391,751-815; SDL:595-624, SDL structs:157-245.

applicability.scope: No observed physical or live consumer reply; intentionally no source-supported byte pattern asserted beyond described code paths.
